nodes.label: Jaxel layered architecture
nodes.rationale: Separates Rust file I/O and encoding, React presentation and interaction, and a UI-free TypeScript core so core logic can be tested headlessly.

nodes.label: Minimal-invasive save
nodes.rationale: Preserves original byte ranges for unchanged nodes and reserializes changed nodes, aiming for best-effort preservation rather than strict byte identity.

nodes.label: XSD and DTD validation excluded
nodes.rationale: The project decision log explicitly excludes schema and DTD validation.

nodes.label: TypeScript XML and JSON parser
nodes.rationale: Parsing in the TypeScript core keeps it headless-testable without a running Tauri app; an 184 MB file was parsed in about eight seconds. A native Rust parser remains a possible later optimization if larger files require it.

nodes.label: Entscheidung: Große Dateien via Streaming-Parse + Index
nodes.norm_label: entscheidung: große dateien via streaming-parse + index
nodes.rationale: Streaming-Parse (quick-xml) → leichter Index (Byte-Offsets + Knoten-Metadaten), ganze Datei im RAM, virtualisierte Baumansicht. Kein >RAM-Editing.

nodes.label: Entscheidung: Round-Trip format-erhaltend best effort
nodes.rationale: Unveränderte Bereiche byte-identisch (Kommentare, PIs, CDATA, Attributreihenfolge, Whitespace), nur geänderte Knoten neu geschrieben. Kein hartes Byte-Identität-Invariant wie bei xdp-designer.
